caption: Grand Canal from Rialto Bridge, Venice
composition: Night view along the Grand Canal from Rialto · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The camera stands on the Rialto Bridge looking down the Grand Canal in the deep pre-dawn dark. Lit palazzi crowd the right bank with glowing arched windows, while the left bank falls into shadow with a lone gondola drifting in the foreground. Warm window light shimmers across the black water toward the distant bend, matching the 04:59 night scenario.
